##Small Avalanche Joseki

This joseki involves a ladder (see <position:27044>). If White occupies D4, then the variation favors White. If White occupies C4 or has no presence in that corner, then this joseki is playable for Black.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 26, Yun Chanhee 6p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1w1Kx2n44tU&t=405s).

[Explanation by New York Institute of Go on Youtube (SDK/Dan)](https://youtu.be/CCf9cqsZVDE?si=9NdVjJltTpclON7E)
